patches.name: claim-mapping-policy
patches.retire_when: An adopted upstream release includes claim mapping and passes the token and migration regressions

patches.name: authorization-code-granted-context
patches.retire_when: An upstream Fosite release restores consented scopes and audiences before authorization-code and device-code token claims are built; remove the go.mod replacement and rerun both protocol regressions

patches.name: api-scope-claim-mapping
patches.retire_when: The upstream claim-mapping implementation accepts OAuth API permission keys in its API and UI

patches.name: cimd-auth-method-negotiation
patches.retire_when: The deployed upstream release negotiates advertised compatible CIMD authentication methods and passes the protocol/cache regressions

patches.name: claim-migration-order
patches.retire_when: Upstream uses the same ordered migration identity; preserve database-version compatibility during adoption

patches.name: initial-user-groups
patches.retire_when: An adopted upstream release supports initial groups in Add User and preserves memberships on later profile edits

patches.name: filter-users-by-group
patches.retire_when: An adopted upstream release filters user membership before pagination and passes the composed-filter and browser regressions

patches.name: access-token-lifetime-rounding
patches.retire_when: An adopted upstream Fosite release truncates access-token expiration consistently across every supported grant, including device code and JWT bearer, and passes the fractional-second regressions; preserve the consented-grant fix when removing the replacement
